PRAVAAS / A better perspective on railway inspection.Built with PyTorch · ONNX Runtime
PRAVAAS / RESEARCH EDITION

From image to evidence.

Choose a detection task, select a sample or upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image, then run inspection. Models execute locally using ONNX Runtime Web.

Rail localization and track obstacles use inherited YOLO models from the reference projects. The Model lab compares a newly trained CNN, frozen MobileNetV3 features, and fine-tuning on the requested Kaggle dataset.

Thresholds filter detector boxes; classification returns two image-level scores. Scores are model confidence, not calibrated safety probabilities.

Explore the model lab →
